source.title: Applied Statistics Immersion — 2026–2027 eleven statistics course cards
source.locator: Ordinary public browser, exact curriculum-table course links and complete settled course popups. No prerequisite-chain expansion.

scope: 11 STAT electives only; five MATH rows are separately reviewed prior evidence and were not re-expanded in this pass. Manual reviews are not runtime parser output.

STAT-205.name: Applied Statistics
STAT-205.description: Descriptive statistics, probability, inference and quality-control techniques, using Minitab for engineering applications.
STAT-205.prerequisites: Prerequisite: MATH-173 or MATH-182 or MATH-182A or equivalent course.
restrictions: No credit if credit is to be earned in STAT-145, STAT-155 or MATH 252; source punctuation is irregular.
Intended for engineering programs; calculus preparation is required.

category_review.locator: STAT-205 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The course teaches statistical concepts and analysis; engineering quality improvement is the application context.

STAT-257.name: Statistical Inference
STAT-257.description: Sampling theory, hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, point estimation and simple regression, with statistical software.
STAT-257.prerequisites: Prerequisites: MATH-251. NOTE: Students cannot receive credit for both MATH-252 and STAT-257 nor for both STAT-205 and STAT-257.

category_review.locator: STAT-257 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The full description centers on statistical inference, estimation and regression methods.

STAT-305.name: Regression Analysis
STAT-305.description: Simple and multiple regression, residual diagnostics, matrix formulations, model selection and other regression models, using SAS.
STAT-305.prerequisites: Prerequisites: MATH-241 and (MATH-252 or STAT-205 or STAT-257) or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: STAT-305 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: Regression models, matrix formulations and model diagnostics are statistical methods; software supports that mathematical focus.

STAT-325.name: Design of Experiments
STAT-325.description: Analysis of variance, multiple comparisons, validation, factorial designs, fixed/random/mixed models, confounding and randomized blocks.
STAT-325.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-325 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The substantive content is statistical experimental design and inference, supported by software.

STAT-330.name: Introduction to Data Visualization
STAT-330.description: Designing graphical data representations, visual encoding and communicating data features, with R used to create graphs.
STAT-330.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.
restrictions: Published GE mathematical-perspective attribute is an institutional designation, not an automatic subject-taxonomy assignment.

category_review.locator: STAT-330 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The description centers on applied data-visualization design and communicating data features, rather than statistical inference theory or general programming.

STAT-335.name: Introduction to Time Series
STAT-335.description: Time-series modeling and forecasting using ARMA/ARIMA, autocorrelation, partial autocorrelation, detrending and residual diagnostics.
STAT-335.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-335 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: Time-series stochastic models and statistical diagnostics are the primary methods.

STAT-345.name: Nonparametric Statistics
STAT-345.description: Distribution-robust inference using binomial tests, contingency tables, ranks, runs and randomization methods.
STAT-345.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-345 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The course centers on nonparametric statistical inference and tests.

STAT-405.name: Mathematical Statistics I
STAT-405.description: Review of probability and distribution theory, followed by distribution properties needed for statistical inference.
STAT-405.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-405 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The description explicitly studies probability distributions and mathematical foundations of inference.

STAT-406.name: Mathematical Statistics II
STAT-406.description: Classical and Bayesian estimation, chi-square tests, the Neyman–Pearson lemma, sufficient statistics and mathematical justification of inference.

category_review.locator: STAT-406 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: The full description concerns mathematical statistics and formal inference methods.

STAT-415.name: Statistical Sampling
STAT-415.description: Survey design and data collection, standard sampling methods and selecting statistical techniques for survey analysis.
STAT-415.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-415 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: Sampling design and analysis are statistical methods; the description does not center on substantive survey-topic content.

STAT-521.name: Statistical Quality Control
STAT-521.description: Probability models and interpretation of continuous/discrete control charts, plus standard quality-control sampling plans.
STAT-521.prerequisites: Prerequisites: STAT-205 or MATH-252 or STAT-257 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: STAT-521 complete rendered course card under the 2026–2027 Applied Statistics Immersion
category_review.rationale: Probability-based control charts and sampling plans form the core, rather than general operations-management practice.
